exposure: Pregnancy extending beyond 40 weeks of gestation
cohort: The study included 114 patients with uncomplicated prolonged pregnancies extending beyond 40 weeks of gestation.
finding: Pregnancy beyond 40 weeks warrants timely termination, with induction of labor being a safe and effective preferred approach that reduces maternal and neonatal risks while minimizing unnecessary surgical procedures.
mod_finding: Labor was induced in 49.12% of participants, with induced patients demonstrating better outcomes and the management of post-term pregnancy not needing to prioritize immediate operative interventions.
